Name: Community Center Icons Redone
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
Didn't you love it when I uploaded my previous mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4163]Profession Icons Redone[/url]﻿, which pointed out inconsistencies in Stardew that you would never have noticed until I pointed it out? Well, I'm here bring you my new mod, which does the same thing but with the [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Bundles]Community Centre bundle[/url]﻿ icons! All patches are configurable by setting them to "false" in the generated ﻿[font=Courier New]config[/font] file.

[b]These icons were changed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Animal Bundle
[*]Artisan Bundle
[*]Adventurer's Bundle
[*]Blacksmith's Bundle
[*]Crops (spring, summer, fall, quality)
[*]Fishing (crab pot, lake, river, ocean, night, specialty)
[*]Foraging (spring, summer, fall, winter, exotic)
[*]Geologist's Bundle
[*]Vault (2,500, 5,000, 10,000, 25,000)
[/list][i]New:[/i]
[list]
[*]Fish Farmer's Bundle
[*]Forest Bundle
[*]Garden Bundle
[*]Master Fisher's Bundle
[*]Rare Crops Bundle
[*]Sticky Bundle
[*]Wild Medicine Bundle
[/list]
I also finally added a comparison image for each bundle. 😅

Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
